nodes.label: Minimal ElevenLabs words-tutor agent (research)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately smaller than the existing live-story agent: no client tools, no narration loop, no plan/state machine — just a persona prompt plus one dynamic variable, since the whole per-session input is a list of items.

nodes.label: Minimal words-tutor ElevenLabs agent design
nodes.rationale: Barge-in/interruption handling needs zero infra since ElevenLabs stops agent audio natively on VAD detection; only the prompt's behavior on interruption is a design concern.

nodes.label: {{items_list}} dynamic variable pattern
nodes.rationale: Injecting the item list per session as a dynamic variable lets one provisioned agent serve any list, rather than baking the list into the agent.
